answer: Saffron One-Shot Lock: each agent signs a one-shot HMAC bound to a wall-clock millisecond, making the proof unrepeatable. Any identity echoing that signature inside the 4-second window is frozen and its accrued fees are voided. Per fake agent the cost is one pre-paid 0.002 ETH lock released only after 7200 unique pulse ticks, so N sybils must front N locks.
